title: Tennessee Taiwanese Association 田納西州大納許維爾台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Tennessee Taiwanese Association (田納西州大納許維爾台灣同鄉會) is a regional chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization for Taiwanese American community associations in the United States. The chapter serves the Taiwanese American community in the Nashville, Tennessee area, as indicated by the Chinese name, which references 大納許維爾 (Nashville). It is affiliated with the TAA’s Mid-Western (美中西) regional grouping.
